title: Verify private corpus builder binding and atomic recovery
preconditions: An isolated Linux owner-only data root provides a public evaluation-purpose classification_v1 projection and explicit labels; injectable file-write boundaries are enabled.
steps: Build canonical subsets in different label orders; replay identical and conflicting idempotency keys; exercise empty, duplicate, malformed, missing-member, inactive-category, oversized, symlink, wrong-owner, permissive, existing-destination, cancellation, write, flush, rename, and post-rename interruption cases; read success with PrivateCorpusReader.
expected: Only explicit labels become dense canonical rows; success bytes and fingerprints are deterministic and reader-compatible; the destination is owner-owned 0600; every failure has no partial final file or unrelated deletion; retry recovers a matching post-rename commit; output and diagnostics remain aggregate-only.
cleanup: Remove the exact isolated root and any test-created owner-only temporary.
